pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which day comes right after Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

2. What does "der Freitag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. day
   C. Friday
   D. Monday

3. What number is "fünf"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 12
   C. 5
   D. 15

4. How is "v" pronounced in "Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. like f
   B. like w
   C. like v
   D. like b

5. What does "die Wand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. sofa
   C. fridge
   D. wall

6. What does "der Topf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. plate
   B. clock
   C. bathroom
   D. pot

7. Which little word goes with the noun "Schlafzimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

8. Which day comes right before Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Montag
   D. Freitag

9. What does "morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. now
   B. today
   C. tomorrow
   D. yesterday

10. Which day comes right before Sonntag? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Samstag
   D. Mittwoch

11. Which German word is the number 6? (1 mark)
   A. fünf
   B. drei
   C. sechs
   D. null

12. What does "Wie viele Kerzen?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Who is coming?
   B. When is the party?
   C. How many candles?
   D. Which cake?

13. Which German word is the number 9? (1 mark)
   A. dreizehn
   B. sechs
   C. acht
   D. neun

14. What is the plural of "die Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bananes
   B. die Banane
   C. die Bananer
   D. die Bananen

15. What does "die Banane" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. meat
   C. banana
   D. cabbage or kale

16. What does "der Bauch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tummy
   B. foot
   C. tooth
   D. neck

17. What does "wolkig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. foggy
   B. wet
   C. cloudy
   D. cold

18. Which verb form completes "Vater ___ ein Buch"? (lesen) (1 mark)
   A. lesen
   B. lese
   C. liest
   D. lest

19. Which German word or phrase means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. die Familie
   B. der Vater
   C. die Tante
   D. die Mutter

20. What does "fleißig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. young
   B. tall or big
   C. hard-working
   D. kind

21. Which room name contains the letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Flur
   B. Zimmer
   C. Küche
   D. Garten

22. Which German word or phrase means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. das Schlafzimmer
   B. die Küche
   C. das Messer
   D. der Teller

23. Which German word or phrase means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. die Party
   B. der Geburtstag
   C. die Kerze
   D. der Luftballon

24. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. Ich möchte tanze.
   B. Ich möchte tanzt.
   C. Ich möchte tanzen.
   D. Ich möchtet tanzen.

25. After "möchte", which form of the verb do we use? (1 mark)
   A. the -st form
   B. the -e form
   C. the -t form
   D. the -en form at the end

26. Which little word goes with the noun "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

27. Which German word or phrase means "orange"? (1 mark)
   A. die Milch
   B. das Wasser
   C. die Orange
   D. die Wassermelone

28. Which food group does "der Apfel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Obst
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Gemüse

29. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Kopf"? (1 mark)
   A. einer
   B. ein
   C. einen
   D. eine

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Nebel"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

32. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)

34. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

35. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

36. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

38. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

39. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

41. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

44. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)

45. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)

46. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

2. C — Friday
   der Freitag means Friday.

3. C — 5
   fünf is the number 5.

4. A — like f
   In most German words v sounds like f: FAH-ter.

5. D — wall
   die Wand means wall.

6. D — pot
   der Topf means pot.

7. B — das
   It is das Schlafzimmer, so the little word is das.

8. D — Freitag
   Before Samstag comes Freitag.

9. C — tomorrow
   morgen means tomorrow.

10. C — Samstag
   Before Sonntag comes Samstag.

11. C — sechs
   6 in German is sechs.

12. C — How many candles?
   wie viele means how many.

13. D — neun
   9 in German is neun.

14. D — die Bananen
   The plural of die Banane is die Bananen.

15. C — banana
   die Banane means banana.

16. A — tummy
   der Bauch means tummy.

17. C — cloudy
   wolkig means cloudy.

18. C — liest
   lesen changes to liest for er.

19. B — der Vater
   father in German is der Vater.

20. C — hard-working
   fleißig means hard-working.

21. C — Küche
   Küche has ü.

22. B — die Küche
   kitchen in German is die Küche.

23. B — der Geburtstag
   birthday in German is der Geburtstag.

24. C — Ich möchte tanzen.
   After möchte comes the -en form tanzen.

25. D — the -en form at the end
   Ich möchte tanzen: the second verb is in the basic -en form and goes to the end.

26. B — das
   It is das Wasser, so the little word is das.

27. C — die Orange
   orange in German is die Orange.

28. B — das Obst
   der Apfel belongs to das Obst.

29. C — einen
   Kopf is a der word, so we say einen.

30. B — der
   It is der Nebel, so the little word is der.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.
